column1: # skips.tsv: every test of SuffixTree.Esa.Tests that a run does not execute, and why (work package S2.2, review finding R04: a skipped test is green).
# Read by docs/refactoring/suffix-tree-upgrade/analysis/ci/skip_accounting.py, which compares it with the .trx of a run and fails on a skip that is not listed
# and on a listed row that is not skipped (so the list cannot rot). Columns, separated by one TAB:
#   kind        ignore          a test that skips itself (Assert.Ignore, Assume, Assert.Inconclusive, [Ignore]): the skips of the run. The default run has 37 of them.
#               explicit        one [Explicit] test method of a class that otherwise runs: never part of a run that does not select it.
#               explicit-class  a whole fixture (with the arguments of a parametrised one, as the .trx names it) that is [Explicit]: none of its tests runs unless selected.
#   test        `Namespace.Class(fixture args).TestName(test args)` as the .trx names it; for explicit-class only the class, as the .trx names it.
#   in_builds   default  an `ignore` that holds in a default build (Release accessor) only: the test RUNS in the checked build, where it must not be skipped.
#               both     holds in every build (a backend that lacks a surface, a combination of parameters that has no such state): skipped in both builds.
#               host     holds only on a host that lacks something (here: `mount -t tmpfs` needs root): may be skipped or run; only has to exist in the run.
#               (explicit rows say `both`: they are not run in either build.)
#   reason      why it does not run, from the test itself.
# A test that is Explicit is not a skip of the default run (the console summary does not count it: 37 skipped, 6,632 passed, total 6,669; the .trx holds 897 not-executed
# results = the 37 + 860 explicit): the list names it so that a test cannot be made Explicit, and so leave the default run, unnoticed. A host row is the only kind that
# may differ between machines; the 9 of this list were found by running the three classes that mount a tmpfs with a `mount` that fails (a runner without root).
# To add a skip on purpose: add a row (skip_accounting.py --propose prints the rows of the skips that are not listed) and say why.
